Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 127. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 40 ki
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Self(100 foot Radius)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
You dart around a large area attacking in rapid
succession. Make 5 combo attack rolls dealing your
unarmed strike damage on a hit before returning to your
starting location.
